title: Open WebUI task endpoints -- T1548 arena wrapper access reaches a restricted underlying model via bypass_filter
author: WinstonRedGuard -- sigma plugin observed rules (derived from breach corpus)
description:
Vendor-disclosed detection for CVE-2026-59225 (GHSA-m3qf-58wf-w979,
CVSS 5.4 MEDIUM), affecting Open WebUI from 0.8.12 before 0.10.0.

An "arena" model in Open WebUI is a wrapper that randomly routes a
request to one of several underlying models. The normal chat route
resolves which underlying model an arena request landed on BEFORE the
final dispatch, and re-checks that resolved model's own access
permission -- so a user with only arena-wrapper access cannot reach a
restricted underlying model through ordinary chat. Task endpoints such
as `/api/v1/tasks/moa/completions`, however, call
`utils.chat.generate_chat_completion()` DIRECTLY, a different code
path where arena-fallback resolution happens AFTER the wrapper's own
access check and then recurses with `bypass_filter=True` -- skipping
the underlying submodel's access check entirely. An authenticated
non-admin user with read access only to the arena wrapper can reach a
restricted model behind it, purely by using the task endpoint instead
of the normal chat route.

Detection logic flags a request to a task-completion endpoint
(`/api/v1/tasks/*/completions`) whose resolved model, after arena
fallback, is one the requesting user has NO direct access grant for --
the exact submodel-access-check skip this advisory describes.

Aggregated from 1 first-party vendor security advisory (open-webui, via
GHSA and NVD, citing the exact function and the `bypass_filter=True`
mechanism by name), fixed in 0.10.0.
